question: Simplify frac{{{x²} + 2x + {y²}}}{{{x³} - 5{x²}}} if X + frac{{{y²}}}{x} = 5.
solution:
Given:

 X + frac{{{y²}}}{x} = 5

Calculation:

 frac{{{x²} + 2x + {y²}}}{{{x³} - 5{x²}}}

⇒ frac{ frac { {x²} + 2x + {y²} }{x}} { frac {{x²} (x - 5)}{x} }

⇒ frac{{ {x} + 2 + frac {y²}{x} }} {x times frac {-y²}{x}} (From given)

⇒ frac{{ 5 + 2}} {-y²} (From given)

⇒ -(7)/(y²)

∴ The simplified answer is -(7)/(y²).
